text:
leah: saw a flurry of restore failures for snapshots pointing at key b7c8d9 during the 11:02 deploy window. Error: NotAuthorizedException on kms:Decrypt.
max.s: Can you paste the error?
leah: `ClientError: NotAuthorizedException: arn:aws:sts::111122223333:assumed-role/snapshot-restorer/session is not authorized to use key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/b7c8d9`
oncall-ops: Sec-bot flagged KMS:PutKeyPolicy at 11:01 by infra-rollback-bot. It replaced the key policy.
max.s: If key policy removed the role, grants won't work. Check list-grants and get-key-policy now.
leah: list-grants empty, policy shows only admin principals. The previous policy snapshot kp-2026-04-01-10:00 includes `role/snapshot-restorer`.
oncall-ops: rolling back policy to kp-2026-04-01-10:00, then adding scoped grant for decrypt with condition `aws:RequestTag/restore-canary=true` for audit.
sec-bot: recommend creating infra rule: block automated applies that change KMS key policies without two human approvals. Created ticket SECURITY-ENC-2602.
compliance: Please export affected snapshot ids and tenant ids within 11:00-11:05. We need timeline and assurance of no exfil.
max.s: got ~12 snapshots across 2 tenants; no outgoing network activity in that window per flow logs. Restores succeeded after rollback + grant.
leah: Postmortem actions: 1) add preflight script to detect KMS principals in rollback plans 2) add high-severity alert for KMS:PutKeyPolicy in prod 3) tag sensitive keys and require `kms-ack` on infra PRs 4) rotate infra bot creds and add owner metadata.
oncall-ops: Opening PR to add `scripts/check_kms_refs.sh` to rollback pipeline and to require `kms-ack` label before merges.
sec-bot: Monitoring elevated for 24h. Closing thread once PR merged.
leah: thanks team, will attach snapshot list to SECURITY-ENC-2602 and follow up on tabletop drill.
